metaTitle: Custom Direct to Film Drinkware | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to film drinkware for vibrant, durable branding. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct to film printing delivers vibrant, full-color graphics on drinkware with exceptional durability, even on curved surfaces. Unlike standard screen printing, DTF transfers allow for intricate designs without setup fees, making it ideal for short runs or multi-color logos. Perfect for promotional tumblers, mugs, and bottles that need to pop in an office or at a trade show.
heroAltText: Custom direct to film drinkware featuring full-color logo on a stainless steel tumbler
